title: Elucidating DNA-binding protein dynamics in Salmonella Typhimurium within macrophages using a breakthrough low-input ChIP-exo approach
authors: Joon Young Park; Minchang Jang; Eunna Choi; Sang-Mok Lee; Ina Bang; Jihoon Woo; Seoyeon Kim; Eun-Jin Lee; Donghyuk Kim
one_liner_zh: 该文开发低输入ChIP-exo方法鉴定沙门氏菌胞内DNA结合蛋白H-NS和RpoD的全基因组结合位点，属纯实验测序技术，无AI或物理模拟建模，仅间接涉及蛋白-DNA互作，与本课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Genome-wide identification of binding profiles for DNA-binding proteins in Salmonella Typhimurium within macrophages is crucial for understanding virulence gene expression and cellular processes. However, this task remains challenging due to the limited amount of intracellular bacterial cells. Here, we present ChIP-mini, a low-input ChIP-exo utilizing 5,000-fold reduced number of initial bacterial cells and analysis pipeline (DiffExo), to identify genome-wide binding dynamics of DNA-binding proteins in host-infected pathogens. Applying ChIP-mini to intracellular S. Typhimurium, we identified 642 and 1,837 binding sites of H-NS and RpoD, respectively, with near-base pair resolution, elucidating their roles in transcriptional initiation. Post-infection, we observed 21 significant reductions in H-NS binding at intergenic regions, exposing the promoter region of virulence genes, such that those in Salmonella pathogenicity islands-2, 3 and effectors, facilitating RpoD binding for transcription initiation. Furthermore, we identified 24 novel RpoD binding sites and 19 significantly increased RpoD bindings at the transcription start sites of virulence genes. These findings substantially enhance our understanding of how H-NS and RpoD simultaneously coordinate the transcription initiation of virulence genes within macrophages. Collectively, this optimized method demonstrates a tool that can be broadly adapted to elucidate transcriptional regulatory networks of host-infected pathogens, revealing critical interactions between host and microbe.
abstract_zh: 对鼠伤寒沙门氏菌（Salmonella Typhimurium）在巨噬细胞内的DNA结合蛋白结合谱进行全基因组鉴定，对于理解毒力基因表达和细胞过程至关重要。然而，由于胞内细菌细胞数量有限，这一任务仍具挑战性。在此，我们提出ChIP-mini，一种利用初始细菌细胞数量减少5,000倍的低输入量ChIP-exo方法及其分析流程（DiffExo），用于鉴定宿主感染病原体中DNA结合蛋白的全基因组结合动态。将ChIP-mini应用于胞内鼠伤寒沙门氏菌，我们分别鉴定了H-NS和RpoD的642个和1,837个结合位点，分辨率接近碱基对级别，阐明了它们在转录起始中的作用。感染后，我们观察到基因间区域H-NS结合显著减少21处，暴露了毒力基因的启动子区域，例如沙门氏菌致病岛-2、-3及效应因子中的那些，从而促进RpoD结合以启动转录。此外，我们鉴定了24个新的RpoD结合位点，以及19处毒力基因转录起始位点处RpoD结合的显著增加。这些发现显著增强了我们对H-NS和RpoD如何在巨噬细胞内协同协调毒力基因转录起始的理解。总体而言，这种优化方法展示了一种可广泛应用的工具，用于阐明宿主感染病原体的转录调控网络，揭示宿主与微生物之间的关键相互作用。
